name: prism1
author: ghjob360
tagline: a six-voice wavetable synth in Vital's image: two wavetable oscillators, warps, spectral morphs, a mod matrix
description: Six voices of two wavetable oscillators (six tables, eight frames each) with unison, Vital-style phase warps (sync, formant, quantize, bend, squeeze, pulse, FM, RM) and spectral morphs, noise, one filter (analog SVF, ladder, formant, comb) with Vital's low-band-high blend, three DAHDSR envelopes with Vital's curves, two LFOs, an eight-slot modulation matrix, and chorus, compressor, delay, distortion, flanger, phaser and reverb in Vital's order.
credits: after Vital by Matt Tytel (GPL-3.0): its oscillator warps, envelope curves and voice architecture, cut down for the FM-1; built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hugelton Instruments)
